information: Online registration starts on Sunday, 3rd June 2018 (03/06/2018) and ends on Friday, 13th July 2018 (13/07/2018). Pre-payment is necessary for confirmation of online registration. On The Spot(OTS) Registration will be available on 20th July 2018 (20/07/2018) from 8:00 AM to 8:30 AM till a competitor limit of 150 is reached. No execeptions will be entertained. Visit [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MonsoonCubeOpenBangladesh2018#6115-registration-details) and [Payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MonsoonCubeOpenBangladesh2018#6120-payment-details) tab for more details.
